player_prompt.intro:
Aƒle wò Countdown dɔwɔƒeƒe ƒuƒoƒo!
Ƒɔɖiɖi: Xɔ si wò kple +, -, *, / ƒe nɔnɔmetɔa ɖe target.
Dɔwɔƒeƒe ƒormat: [i j op] si i,j nye index kple op nye dɔwɔƒe.
Ɖɔɖɔɖɔ: [0 2 *] xɔ si wò ɖe index 0 kple si wò ɖe index 2.
Kɔɖiɖi ɖe na woƒe akɔnta ƒe nɔnɔmetɔa ko.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Dɔwɔƒeƒe ƒormat mɔxe. Tsɔe `[i j op]` si i,j nye index kple op nye +,-,*,/
invalid_move.invalid_indices: Madzedzewo. Ele be woato vovo eye woanɔ 0-{max_index} dome
invalid_move.invalid_operation: Dɔwɔɖui si mesɔ o (woamae na nu alo anye xexlẽdzesi blibo ƒe ŋuɖoɖoa)

outcome.win: Ewɔ dɔ nyuie ŋutɔ! Míekpɔ míaƒe taɖodzinua: {target}
outcome.no_moves: Eŋu nɔnɔ ɖɛ. Tɛtrɛ kple kɔkɔe: {best_value} (target: {target})
outcome.turn_limit: Nuxɔme si me wɔ ɖo. Tɛtrɛ kple kɔkɔe: {best_value} (target: {target})
